extracted.name: Homemade Chocolate Milk Recipe
extracted.description: Learn how to make chocolate milk from scratch with this quick and easy recipe the whole family will love. Ready in just minutes with simple pantry ingredients, it's a creamy, delicious drink kids and adults can't get enough of!
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder (, or more, for richer chocolate taste)
1/2 cup granulated sugar or maple syrup (, or more if you want it sweeter)
1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch (optional) (, for a slightly thicker and smoother texture)
instruction_lines: In a medium saucepan, whisk together cocoa powder, sugar, salt, and cornstarch (if using).
Slowly whisk in 1 cup milk until completely smooth.
Cook over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes, whisking constantly, until smooth and the sugar dissolves. Do not boil.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract. Whisk in 1 more cup cold milk to cool slightly.
Pour into a large pitcher with remaining 6 cups milk. Whisk, blend, or shake very well until combined.
Chill until cold. Shake before serving.
Store covered in the refrigerator until the milk’s expiration date. Shake before each use.
